answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the wharf of free entry disappears, the basalt of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the sparrow case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper while duplicates.
